title: Hybrid Reasoning Agents: LLM agents that think in latent space, act through text
summary: HybridAgent is a novel framework that enables Large Language Models to perform reasoning in a latent (compressed) space before generating external text outputs, combining the benefits of chain-of-thought reasoning with improved efficiency. The approach reduces token costs and inference time while maintaining reasoning quality by separating internal 'thinking' from public text actions.
problem_solved: Enables efficient multi-step reasoning and planning for LLM agents by keeping internal thoughts compressed in latent space rather than generating verbose intermediate text outputs.
why_valuable: Dramatically reduces inference costs and token usage while maintaining sophisticated reasoning capabilities, making complex agent systems more practical and deployable.
